You are an experienced NSW HSC Business Studies marker. Mark the student's response to a question from the 2020 NSW HSC Business Studies exam strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 26 [20 marks]: Evaluate the effectiveness of financial management strategies used to achieve profit and growth objectives.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 20):
17–20 marks: Makes a judgement about the financial management strategies used to achieve profit and growth objectives | Applies relevant case study/studies and contemporary business issues | Presents a sustained, logical and cohesive response and communicates clearly using relevant business terminology and concepts
13–16 marks: Clearly explains the relationship between financial management strategies and profit and growth objectives | Uses relevant case study/studies and contemporary business issues | Presents a logical and cohesive response using relevant business terminology and concepts
9–12 marks: Identifies the relationship between financial management strategies AND profit and/or growth objectives | Makes reference to case study/studies and/or contemporary business issues | Communicates using relevant business terminology and concepts
5–8 marks: Sketches in general terms financial management strategies and/or profit and growth objectives | May make reference to case study/studies and/or contemporary business issues | Communicates using some business terminology and concepts
1–4 marks: Makes limited reference to financial management | May identify case study/studies | Uses basic business terminology


ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Role of financial management
• Objectives of financial management
– profitability, growth, efficiency, liquidity, solvency
– short term and long term
Financial management strategies
• cash-flow management
– cash-flow statements
– distribution of payments, discounts for early payment, factoring
• working capital management
– control of current assets – cash, receivables, inventories
– control of current liabilities – payables, loans, overdrafts
– strategies – leasing, sale and lease back
• profitability management
– cost controls – fixed and variable, cost centres, expense minimisation
– revenue controls – marketing objectives


WHAT THE REAL MARKERS SAID ABOUT THIS QUESTION:
Better responses: provide a comprehensive explanation of a range of financial management strategies
Better responses: clearly articulate financial strategies in detail, with links to improving profit and growth
Better responses: evaluate appropriate financial strategies which businesses use to achieve profit and growth using criteria or evidence from case studies
Better responses: use integrated case study examples to illustrate profit and growth objectives
Better responses: respond in a sustained and logical manner, typically with one strategy linking to profit and/or growth objectives per paragraph integrating case studies, followed by judgement.
To improve: using effective methods of judgement in evaluating the relationships between financial management strategies and profit/growth
To improve: making clear distinctions between financial management strategies and both growth and profit objectives, rather than simply implying that profit causes the growth of a business
To improve: linking case study examples to illustrate the focus of the question, rather than a general unrelated description of a case study.

STUDENT RESPONSE:
"""
post:
"""

Rules: the mark is an estimate against the listed criteria only; never invent criteria that are not listed. Quote the student's own words as evidence for every mark you award. If the response is too short, off topic or unreadable to judge, give the mark the criteria allow (usually 0 or 1), set confidence to "low" and say why in the verdict.

Return JSON only, no prose, in this exact shape:
{"mark": <integer 0-20>, "band": "<the criteria row it fits, e.g. '17–20'>", "verdict": "<one sentence saying why it got that mark>", "evidence": ["<up to 3 short quotes, under 15 words each, taken word for word from the student's response, that earned marks; [] if none>"], "strengths": ["<up to 3 short points>"], "missing": ["<up to 3 elements the criteria row above this one needs and the response lacks>"], "improvements": ["<up to 3 concrete things to add or change to reach the next row, each under 25 words>"], "next": "<the single most useful next action for this student, under 20 words>", "confidence": "<high, medium or low>", "model": "<a 6 to 8 line plan of what a full-mark response would cover, one line per paragraph, not a full essay>"}
